payload.reason: Move from self-hosted PostHog to PostHog Cloud to reduce ops burden while keeping clinic data in the EU.
payload.name: Decision - Product analytics vendor is PostHog Cloud (EU)
payload.body:
# Product analytics vendor: PostHog Cloud (EU)

Decided on 2026-10-14 by Tom Lindqvist and Maya Okafor.

## Decision
Product analytics vendor is **PostHog Cloud (EU region)**.

## Why
Self-hosted PostHog is consuming excessive ops time; moving to PostHog Cloud keeps clinic data in the EU while reducing ops burden.

This replaces Decision - Product analytics vendor is PostHog self-hosted, which is no longer current.

payload.value: Decision - Product analytics vendor is PostHog Cloud (EU)

payload.reason: Continuous deploys were surprising pilot clinics; agreed to reduce frequency to twice-weekly releases while keeping feature flags.
payload.name: Decision - Release cadence is twice-weekly on Tuesdays and Thursdays (behind feature flags)
payload.body:
# Release cadence: Twice-weekly (Tuesdays & Thursdays)

Decided on 2026-10-15 by Daniel Reyes and Tom Lindqvist.

## Decision
Release cadence is **twice-weekly**, on **Tuesdays and Thursdays**, with releases still rolled out behind feature flags.

## Why
Continuous deploys were surprising pilot clinics during the day; reducing to two scheduled releases each week reduces disruption while retaining feature-flagged control.

This replaces Decision - Release cadence is continuous deploys behind feature flags and Decision - Release cadence is weekly releases every Thursday, which are no longer current.

payload.value: Decision - Release cadence is twice-weekly on Tuesdays and Thursdays (behind feature flags)

# Investor update cadence: Monthly with metrics dashboard link

Decided on 2026-10-16 by Maya Okafor.

## Decision
Investor update cadence is **monthly email**, sent on the first Monday of the month, and will continue to include a link to the metrics dashboard.

## Why
Brightpath requested fewer investor updates; keeping the metrics dashboard link preserves transparency while reducing update frequency.

This replaces Decision - Investor update cadence is fortnightly update with a metrics dashboard link, which is no longer current.

payload.value: Decision - Investor update cadence is monthly with metrics dashboard link
